property.title: Foothill Terrace
property.summary: A three-bedroom townhome with a private garage and a garden, on the edge of open country.
property.imageAlt: A row of two-storey townhomes with beige and grey lap siding, gabled roofs, a white two-car garage door and a concrete driveway, with mulched shrub beds and a mown lawn under a partly cloudy sky.
